messages:
rita (AE): Heads-up: ApertureHealth wants a POC for claims automation + clinician FAQ assistant. Their board expects a demo in ~5 weeks. Can we scope endpoints and acceptance criteria?

 dan (SE): Their two main flows: 1) Claim triage where model extracts claim type + recommended action, 2) clinician-facing search that surfaces matching guidelines + citations. Also want drift alerts for policy changes.

 taylor (PM): Draft success criteria: (a) entity extraction recall >= 0.9 on labeled claim fields, (b) guideline retrieval precision@1 >= 0.85, (c) median gen latency < 300ms under 50 qps, (d) no PHI persisted in hosted logs by default.

 nina (Security): Important: HIPAA controls, EU data residency for their EMEA branch, customer-managed KMS for Private. They'll require a brief attestation on encryption at rest + transit. Also need an NDA before sharing their clinical dataset.

 rita (AE): They asked if we can do this in Hosted within 5 weeks or if Private is required for HIPAA. Any quick guidance?

 dan (SE): We can run a limited HIPAA alignment on Hosted if they sign BAA and we enable strict log redaction + retention config. Private is safer for full compliance but will lengthen setup (~2-3 extra weeks). Dedicated reserved slot is a middle ground for performance.

 taylor (PM): Proposed POC plan (5 weeks): Week 0: BAA + creds + infra prep. Week 1: ingest sample claims + build extractors. Week 2: retrieval index + embed tests. Week 3: prompt tuning + run evals. Week 4: scale test + latency tuning. Week 5: demo + acceptance.

 rita (AE): Suggested endpoint map (priority order): 1) POST /api/claim-assist (extract + recommended action), 2) POST /api/guidance-search (embeds + rerank), 3) POST /api/claim-batch (bulk extraction), 4) POST /api/alerts (webhook for drift/security).

 dan (SE): Quick sample for embed call to wire their search:

 ```
 POST /v1/embeddings
 {"model":"redwood-embed-2","input":["ACME guideline text..."]}
 ```

 dan (SE): For rerank we suggest a lightweight candidate set from vector DB then rerank with an NLI-style prompt to improve precision. Emit a confidence score and flag if confidence < 0.6.

 nina (Security): Dataflow summary: ingestion -> vectorization (ephemeral) -> vector DB (configurable residency) -> inference. We'll provide a minimal controls checklist including BAA, SOC2, key rotation, and incident response contact.

 rita (AE): Pricing questions: They requested an estimate for steady 100 qps on Dedicated and a one-week throughput uplift for load testing. Also want to know any credits for pilot.

 billing-bot: Note: pilot credits are handled case-by-case. Please request from finance with expected token volumes and duration. Dedicated pricing estimate requires expected concurrency, avg tokens per call, and model selection.

 taylor (PM): Draft acceptance tests: - Functional: 200 labeled claims, entity extraction recall >= 0.9, action-classification F1 >= 0.8. - Retrieval: 300 query pairs, precision@1 >= 0.85. - Perf: p95 latency < 500ms at 50 qps; spike test 100 qps sustained 10m without errors. - Security: BAA signed, retention policy <= 30d, KMS access control validated.

 rita (AE): Who can own the eval harness and run first baseline? ApertureHealth wants initial numbers by next Tuesday.

 dan (SE): I'll build the harness and run baseline by Mon EOD if they provide dataset and a small DB snapshot. @rita can you confirm dataset ETA?

 rita (AE): I'll push for dataset today and get the legal contact for the BAA. I'll deliver credentials via our secret vault.

 nina (Security): I'll draft the controls checklist and a short note on Hosted vs Private tradeoffs. Send me their security mailbox so I can reply inline.

 taylor (PM): Ops to-do: 1) estimate Dedicated cost for 100 qps (ops), 2) confirm trial uplift window for load test (ops), 3) scheduling: reserve dedicated slot tentatively for Week 4.

 rita (AE): Great. I'll circulate this plan to ApertureHealth and propose the 5-week timeline with these acceptance criteria. Thanks team :rocket:
